description: Regulatory design event for the anchor site: 1%-annual-chance (100-year) flood anchored to the FEMA-effective Base Flood Elevation of 375.0 ft NAVD88 (FIRM panel 18129C0265C). Site constants (BFE 375.0 / LAG 377.2 / FFE 382.5 / BERM 379.8 ft NAVD88) are owner-supplied values carried in tsm-console/src/lib/scientific-analytics.ts. The 24-hour hyetograph is a screening-level triangular design storm — provisional as a storm shape; the BFE/LAG/panel facts are sourced. All depths and damages are computed (simulation), not observed.

structures.name: LAG probe point (377.2 ft, arithmetic only)
